business_summary: Japan Excellent, Inc. (hereinafter, JEI) under the Law Concerning Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations of Japan, is a real estate investment corporation which primarily invests in office buildings. JEI is externally managed by a licensed asset management company, Japan Excellent Asset Management (JEAM). JEAM was originally owned 45% by NIPPON STEEL KOWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD., 20% by The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, 15% by Sekisui House, Co., LTD., and 20% by other corporations. Due to the transfer of ownership by Sekisui House, Co., LTD., on May 12, 2014, ownership interests of 9% and 6% were each acquired by NIPPON STEEL KOWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD., and The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, respectively. Due to the transfers of ownership by The Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, THE DAI-ICHI BUILDING CO., LTD., and SOHGO HOUSING CO., Ltd., from June 25, 2025, to June 27, 2025, an ownership interest of 36% was acquired by Dai-ichi Life Holdings, Inc. JEI was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on June 27, 2006. As of June 30, 2025, JEI held 33 properties with 302,340.95 square meters of total leasable space and had leases with 610 tenants excluding residential tenants. Japan Excellent, inc. was established in February 20, 2006.
business_summary_ko: Japan Excellent, Inc.(이하 JEI)는 일본 투자신탁 및 투자회사에 관한 법률에 의거하여 사무용 건물에 주로 투자하는 부동산 투자회사입니다. JEI는 허가받은 자산운용사인 Japan Excellent Asset Management(JEAM)에 의해 외부적으로 관리됩니다. JEAM은 원래 NIPPON STEEL KOWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD.가 45%, Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited가 20%, Sekisui House, Co., LTD.가 15%, 기타 회사가 20%를 소유했습니다. 2014년 5월 12일 Sekisui House, Co., LTD.의 소유권 이전으로 인해 지분 9% 및 6%가 NIPPON STEEL KOWA REAL ESTATE CO., LTD. 및 Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited에 각각 인수되었습니다. 2025년 6월 25일부터 2025년 6월 27일까지 Dai-ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, THE DAI-ICHI BUILDING CO., LTD. 및 SOHGO HOUSING CO., Ltd.의 소유권 이전으로 인해 Dai-ichi Life Holdings, Inc.가 지분 36%를 인수했습니다. JEI는 2006년 6월 27일 도쿄 증권 거래소에 상장되었습니다. 2025년 3월 30일, JEI는 총 임대 가능 면적 302,340.95㎡의 33개 부동산을 보유하고 있으며, 다음을 제외한 610명의 임차인과 임대 계약을 맺었습니다.
